kineVideo.tip1: Set the phone down: on a tripod, a shelf or a stack of books. Don't hold it in your hand, and don't move the camera during the exercise.
kineVideo.tip2: Frame the whole body, with a little margin. Landscape for a floor exercise, portrait when standing.
kineVideo.tip3: A well-lit room, an uncluttered background, 2 or 3 slow reps: 20 seconds is enough.
kineVideo.tip4: Film yourself or a colleague, never your patient.
